cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded card with Flipkart providing high cashback on Flipkart and Myntra purchases, along with rewards on online shopping, dining, and digital payments.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: 15% off up to INR 500 on EazyDiner.|Minimum Order Value INR 2500
benefitRows.howToAvail: Select the restaurant to be paid on the EazyDiner app.|Enter the amount, and select the offer.|Discount will be applied and net payment will be required to be made.

benefitRows.name: Flipkart
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to your Flipkart account and during checkout, use your Axis Flipkart credit card to access exclusive discounts and offers. Check the Flipkart offers page regularly for updated coupon codes and deals. For assistance, contact Axis Bank customer care at 1860 419 5555.
